title: Fourier coefficient of an empirical sign distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $A$ assign to each element of $\Omega$ a point of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $S\subseteq[n]$. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the sign-cube density induced by the uniform distribution on $\Omega$ equals the uniform average over $\Omega$ of the parity character on $S$ evaluated at $A(\omega)$.
